title: A Silent Mystery
text: Imagine you are standing on the street and your friend is looking at you from a closed glass window on the third floor. They can't hear you, and you can't hear them. How will you tell them to come downstairs?

title: Think About It!
text: Have you ever played a game where you had to explain something to your team without making a single sound? Can you think of all the ways we can 'talk' to someone without actually speaking?

content.title: Expressing without Words
content.description: We use our hands, eyes, and face to communicate.

title: The Power of Sign Language and Expressions
text: Some people cannot hear or speak since birth. But they communicate beautifully using **Sign Language**. In sign language, people use hand movements, finger spelling, and facial expressions to say what they mean. Even in classical dances, dancers use special hand gestures called **Mudras** and facial expressions called **Bhavs** to tell entire stories without saying a word!

content.definition: A way of communicating using hand gestures, facial expressions, and body language instead of spoken words.
Special hand gestures used in Indian classical dance and yoga to express ideas or emotions.

content.question: Which of the following is used in classical dance to tell a story without speaking?

title: Reflection: Silent Cartoons
text: Think about a baby who hasn't learned to speak yet. How does the baby tell its mother that it is hungry or sleepy? Or think about watching a cartoon like Tom and Jerry, where the characters barely talk. How do you always know exactly what they are feeling?

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Many people think that people who cannot speak or hear are less smart. This is completely wrong! They are just as intelligent and simply use a different, beautiful language (Sign Language) to share their thoughts.

content.title: Teacher's Tip
content.text: Ask students to observe each other's faces and guess the emotion: Happy, Sad, Angry, Surprised, Scared. This helps them understand the power of 'Bhavs' (expressions).

title: Making Connections
text: Saying without speaking is everywhere! From the traffic police officer who uses hand signals to control cars, to the umpire in a cricket match who raises a finger to say 'OUT'. Our bodies are amazing communicators.

content.title: Mastery Challenge: Dumb Charades
content.text: Play a game of Dumb Charades! Pick a chit with the name of an animal, a daily activity, or an emotion. Now, act it out for your friends to guess, but remember the rule: No speaking, no making sounds, and no writing letters in the air! Whoever guesses the most actions wins.
